subtopic: Critical Rendering Path, Layout Thrashing and Reflows
question_text: [Web Performance, Caching & Rendering Optimization - Q28] What causes 'Layout Thrashing' in client-side browser DOM manipulation?

options.text: Alternating between writing to DOM geometries (e.g. `el.style.width = ...`) and reading computed geometries (e.g. `el.offsetWidth`), forcing the browser to recalculate layout synchronously in a tight loop
Using CSS grid instead of Flexbox

answer_explanation: Reading geometric layout properties dirty the layout cache. Alternating writes and reads forces repeated synchronous layout reflow passes, stalling the UI thread.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: Reading geometric layout properties dirty the layout cache. Alternating writes and reads forces repeated synchronous layout reflow passes, stalling the UI thread.
